_comment: Confirmed identifications of 2025-276 objects from RF observations (SatNOGS Network + ikhnos Doppler analysis). These override GCAT. Objects listed here are excluded as TORO-2 candidates.

confirmed.name: PHASMA-LAMARR
confirmed.source: Libre Space community, PHASMA thread post 133 (2026-01-28) and SatNOGS DB; confirmed to us by fredy 2026-09-16

satnogs_follow._comment: SatNOGS DB temporary-ID entries that point at a catalog object (norad_follow_id), 2026-09-17

gcat_reliability_note: GCAT assigned H=TORO2, R=CTC-1B, CX=Phasma-Lamarr, CJ=Phasma-Dirac; H and R are proven wrong by RF, so CX and CJ assignments are void too. GCAT also omits 3UCubed-A and WISDOM B has no SatNOGS entry. GCAT names for the remaining unknowns are treated as unverified.
